title: A CHARGED-OFF AND FRAUD loan with NO charge-off reason credits CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY, not the product's reason-mapped account (loan 25 L332: CREDIT account 12 16.67, DEBIT account 23 16.67)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a CAPITALIZED_INCOME_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that IS CHARGED OFF AND FRAUD, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_ZERO_INTEREST_CHARGE_OFF_DELINQUENT_REASON_INTEREST_RECALC_CAPITALIZED_INCOME) at the amortization transaction L332. request.capitalized_income_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 332 (externalId 730673f5-a408-4596-af21-ea40f52fb598, type loanTransactionType.capitalizedIncomeAmortization): interestPortion 16.67 -> "1667" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan read-back carries a NON-REVERSED chargeOff transaction id 331 (externalId 84737143-95a6-4721-978e-69aefca57c4b) with a LOWER id and NO charge-off reason, and the loan's fraud flag is true, so request...charged_off and request...fraud are both true; the loan is NOT written off. request...accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_ZERO_INTEREST_CHARGE_OFF_DELINQUENT_REASON_INTEREST_RECALC_CAPITALIZED_INCOME.json: incomeFromCapitalizationAccountId 6, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 23, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 14, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 12, writeOffAccountId 13. THIS PRODUCT ALSO CARRIES a chargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings entry (code 34 -> account 14), but the observed charge-off request carries NO reason, so the FRAUD branch applies and the amortization credits 12. A port that used the product's reason mapping would post 14 and fail this vector. expect...legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L332 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 724 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 12 amount 16.67 and id 725 DEBIT glAccountId 23 amount 16.67. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a charged-off fraud loan's amortization credits CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE (12), not income from capitalization (6) and not the reason-mapped 14, and debits the same total to deferred income liability. It is the account cell that discriminates both the ignore-loan-state drive and a reason-mapping port. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee portion (zero here), the written-off arm, and the capitalized-income CLASSIFICATION branch (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
